name: meta-strategy-composer
author: MEFAI
summary: One end-to-end pipeline that chains Narrative Rotation, Empirical TP/SL Optimizer, Regime Risk Governor and Risk-Budgeted Allocator into a single backtestable decision: what to trade, where to set TP/SL, whether the regime allows it, and how large, all inside one drawdown budget.

inputs.name: signal_type
inputs.description: buy or sell; null pools both.

inputs.name: top_n
inputs.description: Number of leaders to allocate across.

inputs.name: since_ts
inputs.description: Unix seconds floor for a live forward window.

outputs.name: legs
outputs.description: Per-leg plan: selected symbol, chosen TP/SL, deploy decision, regime scale, leverage, notional, worst-case loss.

outputs.name: portfolio_budget_held
outputs.description: Whether the summed worst-case loss stays inside the drawdown budget.

outputs.name: representative_plan
outputs.description: A single deployable representative leg for display.

primary.description: Selection, brackets and sizing all derive from 195k labeled MEFAI signal outcomes (pinned synthetic sample for reproducible backtests).

backtest.pass_criteria: At least one scenario deploys, every per-leg worst-case loss is bounded, and the portfolio-level summed worst-case loss stays inside the drawdown budget across all scenarios.
